name: ecomate
description: EcoMate SaaS Platform — multi-tenant single deployment (platform API + console + landing + tenant backend/storefront/admin/POS + Caddy edge)
note: SaaS stack — create from the EcoMate repo at ref feat/saas-multitenant (until the branch merges to main). First deploy in the Portainer UI until green; only then wire the deploy-saas.yml webhook. GHCR images are private: register a GHCR registry (PAT with read:packages) in Portainer first. Never delete the license-data volume (holds APP_ENCRYPTION_KEY). Staging and production are two stacks from this same template, differing only in env.
